turns.text: Hello! How have you been lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I buy a laptop now or wait for the sales?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Prices usually drop in about three weeks. Can you get by with your current one until then, or do you need it right away?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold up, my mom is asking me something. Please don't say anything until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hold this laptop for a sec and tell me if it feels heavy?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hmm, it's fine. Lighter than your old one, for sure.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'd carry it on my bike every day though.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then try the silver one next to it. That one's really thin.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The keyboard felt mushy on that one. Did you try typing on it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, I didn't love it either.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Welcome back! How was the trip?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Did you decide whether to buy now or wait for prices to drop?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need it now, I've got a big project starting Monday.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then buy it now. A missed deadline would cost more than the discount.
